plain: A person convicted of a serious crime.

webster.text: In law, a person who has committed felony.

example.quote: The executive of a state is to apply to that of another for the delivery of a felon.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 16, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
